item.title: t54.ai Hosts Stablecoin and Payments Dinner with Ripple at StableCon 2026
item.summary: t54.ai announced an invite-only Stablecoin & Payments Dinner co-hosted with Ripple and QED Investors during StableCon 2026 in Washington, D.C., targeting leaders at the intersection of stablecoins, payments infrastructure, and AI agents.
